records.title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTERLY PERIOD ENDED SEPTEMBER 29, 2024
records.text: As such, during the nine months ended September 29, 2024, we continued to experience a dynamic macroeconomic environment, including price volatility related to select commodities, resulting in corresponding incremental costs and gross margin pressures, and net sales and net income declines.

records.title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTERLY PERIOD ENDED SEPTEMBER 29, 2024
records.text: The net sales decrease was driven by a volume decline of approximately 3%, due to declines across our reportable segments, primarily in salty snack brands.

records.title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTERLY PERIOD ENDED SEPTEMBER 29, 2024
records.text: •In the aggregate, select net working capital items, specifically, trade accounts receivable, inventory, accounts payable and accrued liabilities, consumed cash of $183.9 million in 2024, compared to $449.6 million in 2023.

records.title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTERLY PERIOD ENDED SEPTEMBER 29, 2024
records.text: Despite specific actions taken to mitigate these gross margin pressures, we continue to experience overall declines in consumer demands for our products, and higher prices for direct materials used to manufacture our products were, and continue to be, the primary incremental cost to our business (see Consolidated Results of Operations included in this MD&A).

records.title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTERLY PERIOD ENDED SEPTEMBER 29, 2024
records.text: Operating profit was $613.2 million in the third quarter of 2024 compared to $735.9 million in the same period of 2023, a decrease of $122.7 million, or 16.7%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales generated in the three months ended September 29, 2024 increased $224.8 million, or 5.2%, from net sales generated in the three months ended September 24, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the third quarter of 2024, the U.S. chicken market experienced firm volume demand, supported by growth in both the retail and foodservice distribution channels throughout the quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Export volume in shipments were lower than the five-year historical average for the first two months of the quarter, but were sufficient to prevent buildup of dark meat inventories in cold storage while sustaining price levels that were higher than prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated a consolidated operating margin of 8.9%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income increased by $302.0 million, or 146.3%, from income of $206.4 million generated in the three months ended September 24, 2023 to income of $508.4 million generated in the three months ended September 29, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Our year-over-year revenue decreased ($2.7) million to $194.7 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We continue to experience increased mid- and long-term demand for our power products designed for electrical vehicle applications, and we are working closely with our customer base to best match our supply to their near-term demand.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The significant components of our working capital are liquid assets such as cash and cash equivalents, short-term investments, accounts receivable and inventories, partially reduced by accounts payable and accrued expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit and gross margin were impacted by a less favorable product mix resulting from the softening of demand in industrial and energy applications.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, we have classified the results and cash flows of the RF product line as discontinued operations in our consolidated statements of operations and consolidated statements of cash flows for fiscal 2024.
